title: Implement launch, story navigation and required built-in intents with SSML from Markus
description: Handler (ASK SDK for Python): LaunchRequest reads the latest headlines; ReadStoryIntent (ordinal or title slot), Next, Previous, Repeat; AMAZON.HelpIntent, StopIntent, CancelIntent, FallbackIntent, NavigateHomeIntent; SessionEndedRequest. A Markus to SSML converter escapes text and stays under the speech-length limit. Content comes through the public published-story read path. Gherkin scenarios for every intent against a fake content source.
